name: tt-llk
description: Tenstorrent Low-Level Kernels: the C++ library that directly programs the RISC-V cores inside each Tensix compute engine. TRISC0 (unpack), TRISC1 (math/FPU/SFPU), and TRISC2 (pack) are all programmed through this layer — it is the interface between TT-Metal kernel code and bare silicon.
